2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Mahomes’ return meets Denver’s pass rush in an AFC West reset
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: Kansas City gets Patrick Mahomes back from major knee surgery, but his first regular-season test comes against a Denver defense that led the NFL in sacks last season. The Broncos also return Bo Nix and added Jaylen Waddle to stress a rebuilt Chiefs secondary. With Kansas City left tackle Josh Simmons unavailable, protection against Nik Bonitto and Denver’s front is central; on the other side, Kansas City must prevent Nix and Waddle from generating explosive plays against new defensive-back personnel.

Its frozen F-ST engine reconciles a 31.6% football-only signal with a 54.3% vig-free market signal under the 2026 production specification; it is not a fixed arithmetic blend. That official probability translates to a probability-implied presentation line of Kansas City Chiefs -2.3, a market line of Kansas City Chiefs -2.5, and an approximate coherent score of KC 24 – DEN 22. Kansas City’s quarterback stability and home environment meet a difficult protection matchup, while Denver’s pressure and upgraded receiving speed create credible paths to disrupt the Chiefs on both sides. The pick: Kansas City Chiefs moneyline.
